thread:
maria-g: heads up — staging GPU warmup is stalled after the infra push this morning. lots of PENDING warmup pods and node requeues. seeing keystore decrypt errors in node boot logs.
ajay: paste one of the errors?
maria-g: `2026-09-03T07:42:12Z keystore: decrypt failed AccessDeniedException principal=arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/staging-node-reconciler` then several `attempt=3/5` retries.
ajay: tried curl from a repro instance: `curl -v https://keystore.internal.staging:8443/health` -> connected then `403 {"error":"access denied"}`.
olivia: did any TF changes touch staging SGs or privatelink?
maria-g: yeah PR #4891 tightened egress on `staging-app-sg` to a narrow CIDR for compliance. I flagged it but it merged during a blitz.
sre-bot: [deploy-bot] terraform apply tf-20260903-4891 performed by infra-ci at 2026-09-03T07:33:20Z
ajay: quick look at NAT metrics shows a huge burst of ephemeral connections — conntrack drops spiking. nodes were retrying keystore decrypts and exhausting NAT ports.
maria-g: that explains the PENDINGs — warmup jobs keep retrying and autoscaler keeps scaling up. cost dashboard shows ~+$3.9k over the last 45m.
olivia: mitigation options: 1) revert the SG egress rule 2) add an explicit allow for keystore CIDR/proxy 3) patch node init to skip keystore (bad).
ajay: I did a temporary node-init patch to skip keystore decrypt on warmup to unblock queues but it leaves keys unwrapped in memory — not acceptable long term. It cut the immediate PENDING backlog but increased churn.
ajay: command I ran to restore access: `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0staging --protocol tcp --port 8443 --cidr 10.12.0.0/16` then I bumped NAT gateway idle timeout and rotated the ephemeral port range test.
sre-rotation: starting a controlled drain of affected nodepool gpustage-2 to prevent further autoscaler churn. ETA ~10m.
maria-g: after the SG rollback curl now returns `200 {"status":"ok"}` and warmup pods are progressing. autoscaler stabilized.
olivia: good. still need a full incident and postmortem: why TF allowed egress tightening without a smoke check, why staging keystore was in the same SG scope, and how to prevent NAT port exhaustion cascades.
security-svc: we need an audit trail for the rollback. do not merge a rollback change without documented approval in the incident. also capture KMS policy diffs — if KMS denied, rollback won't help.
audit-bot: fetching last 48h KMS and STS AssumeRole events for staging nodes, will attach to INC-2026-3041. (2m)
ajay: journalctl excerpt saved to incident: `Sep 03 07:42:12 node-init keystore[1034]: decrypt failed AccessDeniedException principal=arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/staging-node` and NAT metrics: `conntrack_overflows=1245`.
maria-g: opened incident INC-2026-3041, tagged infra-eng and sec-compliance, added cost flag.
olivia: follow-ups to implement before close: 1) TF pipeline smoke test for keystore health whenever staging SG/egress rules change (`curl --fail https://keystore.internal.staging:8443/health`) 2) guardrail to prevent SG egress reductions that would remove keystore cidr unless exception approved 3) add ephemeral port math into our load tests and an alert for conntrack/port exhaustion 4) add short-term budget alert for warmup node spikes to page on cost.
ajay: also recommend we move keystore behind a privatelink with explicit VPC endpoints so node egress changes don't break it in future. makes the dependency explicit.
security-svc: agree on privatelink plan, but will need to update KMS key policy and IAM role trust boundaries — schedule review.
maria-g: assigning action owners in the incident. marking mitigation complete for now since warmup progressed and autoscaler calmed. will keep it open until postmortem and TF gate added.
sre-bot: [incident] INC-2026-3041 created by maria-g at 2026-09-03T08:12:01Z — severity P2 (cost + availability).

(Notes: short, choppy messages; inline commands and log snippets; @mentions implicit by names; reactions omitted for brevity.)
